requirements.summary: Update deployment guidance/checklist to support a standard production redeploy and verification of the live romanticproposal.icp0.io site showing the latest UI (including the “She said yes” success heading).
acceptanceCriteria: A production deployment is executed using the project’s standard deployment workflow.
https://romanticproposal.icp0.io loads successfully in a browser and displays the latest UI (including the success screen heading text "She said yes").
No deployment/build errors remain blocking the publish step.

file_operations.description: Expand and complete the production redeploy instructions (install/build/deploy steps) and add a post-deploy verification checklist that explicitly includes: opening https://romanticproposal.icp0.io, clicking “Yes! 💕”, and confirming the success screen heading reads “She said yes”, plus basic troubleshooting notes for common build/deploy failures. Keep changes documentation-only to avoid altering app behavior.

Align example/help text to reference the production subdomain 'romanticproposal' (lowercase) and the expected URL https://romanticproposal.icp0.io, so the standard workflow guidance matches the actual production target. No functional rule changes required beyond copy updates.
